name: Guided ascent: payload sweep
description: The two-stage rocket again, with the same payloads as the other payload sweep, but flying the guided ascent: above 30 km it steers by feedback, holding the high point of its path at 200 km while it builds speed. Every load up to 3 t ends in a 200 km orbit, with no tuning of the kick. The open-loop plan, which decides the whole climb in the first seconds, needed a gentler kick and managed 2.5 t.
